correctness.rationale: For any strictly positive period-two orbit, exact sums of normalized prey and predator updates yield \(S_x<2(a-1)/a\) and \(S_y<2(b+d-1)/b\), forcing \(a>1\) and \(b+d>1\). The arithmetic–harmonic inequality gives \(R_x>a\) when \(a\le3\) and \(R_y>b\) when \(b+d\le3\). Subtraction gives a homogeneous two-by-two system with positive determinant \((R_x-a)(R_y-b)+cd\), forcing both coordinate increments to vanish. Endpoints use strictly positive cross-couplings and the automatic bound \(S_x<2\). Sharpness follows by implicit-function continuation of the scalar logistic two-cycle from zero coupling, for \(3<r<1+\sqrt6\); its two-step multiplier \(4+2r-r^2\) belongs to \((-1,1)\). Symbolic identities were independently reconstructed and the explicit \(r=16/5\) examples checked using the delivered checker. Numerical diagnostics do not supply the infinite-parameter proof.

originality.rationale: The open full text of the direct 2024 study gives the exact coupled-logistic equations and a local flip normal form, not a global positive two-cycle exclusion or the two sharp uniform parameter thresholds. Older same-model numerical work (1990), related analytical bifurcation work (2018), and symmetric-coupling normal forms (2022) were identified; their accessible descriptions do not supply the statement. The nearest indexed global no-two-cycle result is for a different predator equation with no quadratic predator self-limitation. Inaccessible older full texts and mathematically equivalent formulations are residual priority risks.

value.rationale: Gives a global, rigorously sharp in both coordinate ceilings, two-cycle-free region for a natural studied nonlinear predator–prey map. This distinguishes no oscillatory period-two coexistence from local equilibrium stability or numerical non-observation and remains valid without a globally invariant population rectangle. The two independently sharp limits connect directly to the classical scalar logistic flip threshold, with nonzero bidirectional interactions persisting. It does not claim a global attractor classification or an unrestricted necessary-and-sufficient phase diagram.
